name: Private first setup
author: wizard
description: New installs start private: connecting Tinfoil first makes one private agent the box's agent, with every app and every app's work going to it. Connecting Claude or ChatGPT adds a separate standard agent that starts with no apps; your private agent's model and apps never change. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 545); a box set up before the switch keeps its agents as they are.
